title: VTG Playboy Magazine March 1989 La Toya Jackson Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from March 1989 featuring La Toya Jackson, complete with the centerfold. This English-language publication focuses on art & photography, with a genre catering to men interested in photography and modeling. Published by Playboy in the United States, this monthly magazine is part of the controlled circulation distribution, making it a sought-after collectible for fans of classic men's lifestyle content.
